email.subject: Core Pros Fitness site: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I checked Core Pros Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: it doesn't display correctly on phones, and there's no tap-to-call button, so anyone searching "gym near me" on their phone can't quickly reach you or even read the page right. The footer also still shows old info, which can make new visitors second-guess if you're active.

I fix issues like these for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's broken and how it'd look fixed? No obligation.

Alex
Northlight Web
